headerDisplay: Controls Korean Navien boiler room controllers (NR-35D / NR-36D / NR-40D) that are registered in the 나비엔 스마트 app. Navien allows one login per account: while this plugin is running, the 나비엔 스마트 app will be logged out, and opening the app logs the plugin out until its next request.

heatingMode.title: Heating thermostat controls
heatingMode.description: 실내난방 sets the room temperature, 온돌난방 sets the floor water temperature. 'Both' adds one thermostat per mode.

oneOf.title: Automatic (실내난방 if the boiler has it, otherwise 온돌난방)

hotWaterOnlySwitch.title: Add a 온수전용 (hot water only) switch

homeSeq.title: Home number (homeSeq)
homeSeq.description: Only needed when the account has several homes. The log lists them at startup.

debug.title: Log every message exchanged with the boiler
